how_measured: Each AL_D194 zip's first 64KB was read by ranged request and the inner shapefile member name (AL_D194_<sigungu>_<yyyymmdd>) taken from the local file header; byte sizes come from the bucket listing. 51 objects in a separate DS00179 series whose inner name did not resolve are excluded; the three DS00178 vintages each already cover the full 252 sigungu, so the national covering is complete without them.
field_layout_authority: Column meaning is confirmed by the provider's own named CSV export of the same dataset (vworld dtmk_ntads_s002.do?svcCde=NA&dsId=4): the CSV Korean headers match the DBF A-column order (A0 is an internal serial absent from the CSV, so A1 onward aligns). A1=고유번호, A11=지목명, A12=토지면적, A18=토지이용상황, A20=지형높이, A22=지형형상, A24=도로접면, A25=개별공시지가 (root ADR-0087).
why_this_file_exists: The prefix piles up harvest vintages of the same 252 sigungu, and the object names (20171128DS00178-N.zip) say nothing about which sigungu or vintage is inside. Loading two vintages would double every parcel's characteristics, and loading 251 of 252 sigungu would look complete while one is silently missing.
consistency_check: The selected vintage has exactly one object per each of the 252 sigungu codes.
handoff_prefix_reason: Where the converted handoff objects live — declared once so the exporter and loader cannot drift (same reason as the land-use and price contracts).
handoff_suffix_reason: The converter names the object and the loader derives the same name; .gz also tells the converter to compress and Spark to decompress.
